messages.ee5ebc1ac9c8af20: Ukusetha ngokutsha kuya kucima ngokusisigxina indawo yokugcina amayeza arhoxisiweyo, ukutshintsha imbali, kunye nelog yokuthatha. Qhubeka?
messages.eef0abe9f43d061f: Ikopi efihliweyo engaphelelanga ayifumanekanga. Akukho nto itshintshileyo.
messages.f3fe9942107a89af: Iifayile ezingaxhunyiwe kwi-intanethi zilungisiwe kwaye zaqinisekiswa.
messages.f698bc440cabcde7: Umzekelo: 500 mg / 1 tablet / Vitamin D 2000 IU
messages.f700bad1fa9bf26c: Faka igama lokugqithisa lefayile kwindawo eyahlukileyo (ubuncinci amagama ali-12)
messages.fc064c0ab095fa4b: Akukho ngxelo yesiganeko esigciniweyo kule rekhodi yakudala. Idatha engasentla yirekhodi yekhosi yonyango egciniweyo, kungekhona imbali eyakhiwe ngokutsha.
messages.ffdc6cc67a30cb67: Yonke imihla - ukuthathwa kweyeza elicwangcisiweyo lenziwa yonke imihla ngexesha elichaziweyo.
